allow: PowerShell($body = @{ email = "luana@email.com"; senha = "Luana@2025" } | ConvertTo-Json; $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/login" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json"; $token = $response.data.token; $headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token" }; $sessoes = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/sessao" -Method GET -Headers $headers; "Status sessoes: OK - $\($sessoes.success\)")

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/health" -TimeoutSec 8 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($r\) { "OK $\($r.StatusCode\): $\($r.Content\)" } else { "Sem resposta" })
